verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX PRO 6000 product page documents DLSS 4 AI-powered upscaling for this card, but frames it around real-time photorealistic rendering for professionals, not gaming. Frame generation is not explicitly documented for the part; the Optical Flow SDK's video frame interpolation is a separate developer feature and doesn't count. There is no evidence of game support or gaming performance on this workstation card. Missing for 10: documented DLSS frame generation on this part, evidence of broad game support, and independent or hands-on gaming corroboration.
